```{ojs}
API_BASE = (
  (location.hostname === "localhost" ||
   location.hostname === "127.0.0.1") &&
  location.port !== "10000"
)
  ? "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
  : ""

apiJson = async path => {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`)

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `API indisponible (${path}) : HTTP ${response.status}`
    )
  }

  return await response.json()
}

dashboardPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/publications")
labsPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/labs")
partnersPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/partners")
authorsPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/authors")

publications = dashboardPayload.items ?? []
publicationLabsCluster = labsPayload.items ?? []
publicationPartners = partnersPayload.items ?? []
publicationAuthors = authorsPayload.items ?? []
```

```{ojs}
yearOptions = [
  "Toutes",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.year)
        .filter(d => d != null)
        .map(d => String(d))
    )
  ).sort()
]

pillarOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.pillar)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]

axisOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.axis)
        .filter(
          d =>
            d &&
            d.trim() !== "" &&
            d !== "No class"
        )
    )
  ).sort()
]

labOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publicationLabsCluster
        .map(d => d.lab)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]
```

```{ojs}
html`
<section class="hero-banner">
  <div>
    <div class="hero-kicker">CLUSTER SEQUOIA</div>
    <h1>Écosystème scientifique</h1>
    <p>Laboratoires, partenaires privés et auteurs les plus actifs du corpus.</p>
  </div>

  <div class="hero-meta">
    <strong>${publications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
    <span>publications dans le corpus</span>
  </div>
</section>
`
```

:::

::: {.filter-card}
**AXE SCIENTIFIQUE**

```{ojs}

```
:::

::: {.filter-card}
**LABORATOIRE**

```{ojs}
viewof selectedLab = Inputs.select(labOptions, {value: "Tous"})
```
:::

:::

```{ojs}
publicationKey = d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s

selectedLabPublicationIds = new Set(
  selectedLab === "Tous"
    ? publications.map(publicationKey)
    : publicationLabsCluster
        .filter(d => d.lab === selectedLab)
        .map(d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s)
)

filteredPublications = publications.filter(d =>
  (selectedYear === "Toutes" || String(d.year) === selectedYear) &&
  (selectedPillar === "Tous" || d.pillar === selectedPillar) &&
  (selectedAxis === "Tous" || d.axis === selectedAxis) &&
  (selectedLab === "Tous" || selectedLabPublicationIds.has(publicationKey(d)))
)

filteredPublicationIds = new Set(
  filteredPublications.map(publicationKey)
)
```

```{ojs}
filteredLabRelations = publicationLabsCluster.filter(
  d => filteredPublicationIds.has(d.publication_id)
)

filteredPartnerRelations = publicationPartners.filter(
  d => filteredPublicationIds.has(d.publication_id)
)

filteredAuthorRelations = publicationAuthors.filter(
  d => filteredPublicationIds.has(d.publication_id)
)
```

```{ojs}
labActivity = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredLabRelations,
    rows => new Set(rows.map(d => d.publication_id)).size,
    d => d.lab
  ),
  ([lab, publications]) => ({lab, publications})
)
.sort((a, b) => b.publications - a.publications)
.slice(0, 10)

partnerActivity = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredPartnerRelations,
    rows => new Set(rows.map(d => d.publication_id)).size,
    d => d.partner
  ),
  ([partner, publications]) => ({partner, publications})
)
.sort((a, b) => b.publications - a.publications)
.slice(0, 10)

authorActivity = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredAuthorRelations,
    rows => new Set(rows.map(d => d.publication_id)).size,
    d => d.author
  ),
  ([author, publications]) => ({author, publications})
)
.sort((a, b) => b.publications - a.publications)
.slice(0, 10)

activeLabs = new Set(
  filteredLabRelations.map(d => d.lab)
).size

activePartners = new Set(
  filteredPartnerRelations.map(d => d.partner)
).size

activeAuthors = new Set(
  filteredAuthorRelations.map(d => d.author)
).size

shortLabel = (value, max = 27) => {
  const text = String(value || "")
  return text.length > max
    ? `${text.slice(0, max - 1)}…`
    : text
}
```

```{ojs}
html`
<section class="ecosystem-summary">

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">LABORATOIRES</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${activeLabs.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">représentés dans la sélection</span>
  </article>

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">PARTENAIRES PRIVÉS</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${activePartners.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">associés aux publications</span>
  </article>

  <article class="ecosystem-stat">
    <span class="metric-label">AUTEURS</span>
    <strong class="metric-value">
      ${activeAuthors.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
    </strong>
    <span class="metric-note">présents dans la sélection</span>
  </article>

</section>
`
```

## Publications associées


:::

::: {.publication-search-card}

**RECHERCHE PAR TITRE OU AUTEUR**

```{ojs}
viewof publicationSearch = Inputs.text({
  placeholder: "Ex. transformer, Dupont, robotique..."
})
```

:::

```{ojs}
publicationSearchQuery =
  String(publicationSearch || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()

displayedPublications = filteredPublications
  .filter(
    d =>
      publicationSearchQuery === "" ||
      String(d.title || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery) ||
      String(d.authors || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery)
  )
  .slice()
  .sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0) ||
      String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""))
  )
```

```{ojs}
html`
<div class="publication-result-summary">
  <strong>${displayedPublications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
  publication${displayedPublications.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
  correspondant à la sélection
</div>
`
```

::: {.publication-card}

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(
  displayedPublications.map(d => ({
    Année: String(d.year ?? ""),
    Titre: d.title || "",
    Auteurs: d.authors || "",
    Pilier: d.pillar || "",
    Axe: d.axis || "",
    Statut:
      d.classification_status === "to_review"
        ? "À confirmer"
        : "Validé",
    Citations:
      d.citations == null || d.citations === ""
        ? ""
        : Number(d.citations),
    HAL: d.url || "",
    DOI: d.doi || ""
  })),
  {
    rows: 8,

    columns: [
      "Année",
      "Titre",
      "Auteurs",
      "Pilier",
      "Axe",
      "Statut",
      "Citations",
      "HAL",
      "DOI"
    ],

    width: {
      Année: 70,
      Titre: 330,
      Auteurs: 240,
      Pilier: 145,
      Axe: 200,
      Statut: 105,
      Citations: 85,
      HAL: 85,
      DOI: 85
    },

    format: {
      Citations: value =>
        value === "" || value == null
          ? "—"
          : value.toLocaleString("fr-FR"),

      HAL: value =>
        value
          ? html`<a href=${value} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">HAL</a>`
          : "",

      DOI: value => {
        if (!value) return ""

        const doiUrl =
          String(value).startsWith("http")
            ? value
            : `https://doi.org/${value}`

        return html`<a href=${doiUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DOI</a>`
      }
    }
  }
)
```
